content: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure firewall is TWO layers: (1) OCI Console - VCN > Security Lists > Add Ingress Rule: Stateless=No, Protocol=TCP, Source CIDR=0.0.0.0/0, Destination Port=7860. (2) OS-level firewall inside VM - Oracle Linux uses firewalld: sudo firewall-cmd --zone=public --permanent --add-port=7860/tcp && sudo firewall-cmd --reload. Alternatively iptables: sudo iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport 7860 -j ACCEPT. BOTH layers must be configured — OCI security list is necessary but not sufficient. Source: docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Network/Concepts/securitylists.htm and marcinmitruk.link
